question: How will the Commission ensure that the EU framework for short-term accommodation rental data collection and sharing1 is implemented in a way that supports evidence-based policymaking and transparency, while ensuring that Member States, including Ireland, do not introduce disproportionate market access (planning) restrictions that go beyond the objectives of improving data availability and regulatory cooperation?

Regulation (EU) 2024/1028 of 11 April 2024 on data collection and sharing relating to short-term accommodation rental services and amending Regulation (EU) 2018/1724 (OJ L, 2024/1028, 29.4.2024, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1028/oj). 1
